questions.q: Who was Canada's first Prime Minister?
questions.why: He took office at Confederation in 1867.

questions.q: In which year did Canadian Confederation take place?
questions.why: Ontario, Quebec, Nova Scotia and New Brunswick joined on 1 July 1867.

questions.q: On what date is Canada Day?
questions.why: It marks Confederation.

questions.q: Which explorer claimed land for France at Gaspé in 1534?
questions.why: He planted a cross on the Gaspé Peninsula.

questions.q: Who founded Quebec City in 1608?
questions.why: He is called the 'Father of New France'.

questions.q: Which railway, finished in 1885, linked Canada from coast to coast?
questions.why: The last spike was driven at Craigellachie, BC.

questions.q: Which Prime Minister brought the Constitution home from Britain in 1982?
questions.why: It included the Charter of Rights and Freedoms.

questions.q: Which 1759 battle at Quebec decided the fate of New France?

questions.q: Which First World War battle in April 1917 became a symbol of Canadian nationhood?
questions.why: All four Canadian divisions fought together for the first time.

questions.q: Which territory was created in 1999?
questions.why: It was split from the Northwest Territories.

questions.q: Which Métis leader led the Red River Resistance of 1869–70?

questions.why: He proposed the first UN peacekeeping force.

questions.q: In which year did Newfoundland join Canada?
questions.why: It was the last province to join.

questions.q: Which 1931 law gave Canada full control of its own laws?
questions.why: It applied to several British dominions.

questions.q: Which two provinces were created in 1905?
questions.why: They were carved from the Northwest Territories.

questions.q: What is the capital of Canada?

questions.q: What is Canada's largest city?

questions.q: How many provinces does Canada have?
questions.why: It also has three territories.

questions.why: The Horseshoe Falls are on the Canadian side.

questions.q: Which province is mainly French-speaking?
questions.why: New Brunswick is officially bilingual.

questions.q: Vancouver lies on which ocean?

questions.q: What is Canada's longest river?

questions.q: What is Canada's highest mountain?

questions.q: Which bay has the highest tides in the world?

questions.q: Which is Canada's smallest province?

questions.q: What is the capital of Nunavut?

questions.q: Which is the largest lake entirely within Canada?
questions.why: It is in the Northwest Territories.

questions.q: Regina is the capital of which province?

questions.q: Which hockey player is called 'The Great One'?

questions.q: What is the Canadian Football League's championship called?
questions.why: It was first played in 1909.

questions.q: Which Toronto team won the 2019 NBA championship?

questions.q: Which sport is played with stones and brooms on ice?
questions.why: Canada has won many Olympic curling medals.

questions.q: What is Canada's national summer sport?
questions.why: It comes from Indigenous games.

questions.q: Which Canadian city hosted the 2010 Winter Olympics?
